database.title: Database backup and restore
database.intro: Back up accounts, settings, visibility rules, and saved storage connections. File contents are not included: copy local files separately or reconnect existing external storage.
database.phrase_help: Save these words in order. You need all 12 words to restore this backup. Keep them separate from the backup file. This export expires in 10 minutes.
database.recorded: I saved the phrase — verify words
database.challenge_help: Enter the requested words to confirm you saved the recovery phrase. Five failed attempts require a new export.
database.backup_file: Encrypted backup file (.oasis-backup, up to 64 MiB)
database.migration_help: Select the folder containing your copied local files. Environment encryption keys, SSH keys, certificates, and server configuration must be moved separately. Storage encryption keys must match the originals.
database.replace_warning: Restoring replaces this installation's accounts and settings. All existing sessions and shared links will stop working. Files are not moved or deleted. After restoring, sign in with an account from the backup.
database.confirm_replace: Replace this installation with the backup
database.restoring: Restoring — do not start another operation...
database.copy_manual: Automatic copying is unavailable. Select and copy the phrase below.
database.exported: Encrypted backup downloaded. Keep your recovery phrase separately.
database.expired: Backup operation expired. Start again to continue.
database.select_file: Select an encrypted Oasis backup file.
database.too_large: Database backups are limited to 64 MiB.
database.request_failed: Database operation failed. Check your administrator session and try again.

external_storage.b2_help: Uses the native Backblaze B2 API. Select an existing bucket and optional prefix; endpoints are discovered automatically. Deletes permanently remove the current file version. Older overwritten versions follow your B2 lifecycle rules.
external_storage.title: External storage
external_storage.local_inactive: Not used for regular files while an external main drive is active.
external_storage.intro: Connect external storage through Oasis. Connection changes do not move or migrate existing files.
external_storage.main: Use an external provider as the main drive
external_storage.mount: Show external providers as folders alongside local storage
external_storage.main_help: Regular files are stored on the selected external provider. Local storage is used only for temporary processing and Oasis configuration.
external_storage.mount_help: Each provider appears as a folder on the main screen using its drive name. Your local files remain accessible.
external_storage.name: Drive name
external_storage.list_help: Changes are saved only when you select Save storage settings. Removing a provider does not delete its files.
external_storage.empty_list: No external storages configured. Add a provider to get started.
external_storage.key_file: SSH private key path on this server (optional)
external_storage.known_hosts_file: SSH known_hosts path on this server
external_storage.implicit_tls: Use implicit FTPS (default port 990); otherwise use explicit TLS
external_storage.s3_help: Leave credentials blank to use the server AWS credential chain. Leave the endpoint blank for AWS S3; set it for S3-compatible providers.
external_storage.sftp_help: Use a password, an SSH key file, or the server SSH agent. A trusted known_hosts file is required.
external_storage.ftp_warning: FTP is insecure: credentials and data travel without transport encryption. Prefer SFTP or FTPS. File encryption does not protect FTP credentials.
external_storage.http_warning: HTTP does not encrypt the connection. Use an HTTPS endpoint to protect credentials and data in transit.
external_storage.encryption: Encrypt file contents and names with AES-256
external_storage.key_placeholder: At least 12 characters, or use OASIS_STORAGE_KEY
external_storage.key_help: Use a passphrase of at least 12 characters (up to 1,024 UTF-8 bytes), or a 64-character hexadecimal key. Case and spaces in passphrases are significant. OASIS_STORAGE_KEY overrides the saved secret. New encrypted storage needs an empty, dedicated remote folder. Downloads and previews are decrypted automatically. Encryption still exposes approximate sizes, folder structure and access patterns.
external_storage.key_warning: Back up this key. Changing or losing it makes existing files unreadable. Oasis rejects key changes for an existing encrypted namespace; moving data to a new key requires a separate migration.
external_storage.temporary_help: Temporary server copies are removed when an operation or response ends, including failed operations. Abandoned uploads expire after one hour. Provider files remain until you delete or move them. Requires rclone 1.71+ on the server.
external_storage.test_success: Connections verified. Saving will initialize any new encrypted storage.
external_storage.request_failed: Could not update storage settings. Check your administrator session and server connection.
